customizations.title: Customizations
customizations.description: One row per specific configuration rule applied to a device. Removing on a device row only affects that device (the rule is fully deleted if it only targeted it); removing on a configuration affects every device using it. The global rule (e.g. {targetsAll}) keeps running in the background.
